fix: Work in batches of about 15 files, one commit per batch and one PR per about 30 files. Follow skills/docs-write and docs/conventions/ste100-writing.md. Keep every fact, file:line reference, table, link and code block. Keep headings and anchors stable, or fix every inbound link. Do not edit generated regions; regenerate them with their generator. Run evolve docs ste-lint --strict on the touched files (0 findings), evolve docs index check, and the docs-review skill on each PR. Regenerate the baseline with evolve docs ste-lint --strict . to choose the next batch. Tier 1 starts after the open PRs 1142 to 1145 merge. Change the required.yml step last, only after tiers 1 and 2 report 0 findings.
